name: Ariakit
summary: Composable, accessibility-focused headless components with a small install (about 18 MB with React) and a clean dialog spike. Held because it is still 0.x and has a smaller catalogue than React Aria or Base UI.
losses: Only the dialog primitive was spiked

spike.scenario: Dialog, React 19.2.0, plain CSS, Vite production build, 1200x800 Chrome screenshot.
spike.notes: role=dialog, labelledby and describedby present, focus inside the dialog. aria-modal was not observed on the role=dialog element.
